rulesetBuilder.abilitiesHelp: The scores a check adds or rolls, with their range and starting value. Stats with the same group show under one heading on the sheet.
rulesetBuilder.displayHelp: Number alone, or with a fill bar or a row of dots on the sheet. More than 20 dots show as a bar.
rulesetBuilder.fieldsHelp: Free entries on the sheet, such as a concept or a background.
rulesetBuilder.ladderHelp: The names the narrator picks from when it asks for a check, each with the number to reach.
rulesetBuilder.ladderHelpPool: The names the narrator picks from when it asks for a check, each with the successes needed.
rulesetBuilder.listsHelp: Things a character collects, such as gear, moves or scars. Every row has a name, plus the columns you add. Each list gets its own tab on the sheet, named after the list unless you give another name; lists with the same tab name share a tab.
rulesetBuilder.name: Name
rulesetBuilder.nameRequired: Give the ruleset a name first
rulesetBuilder.poolsHelp: What play spends and refills, such as Health or Stress, with a maximum.
rulesetBuilder.practiceHelp: Each trained skill shows how far it is toward its next rank, from 0 to 99%. Practice in the story raises it, and a rank-up starts it over. A rank still changes only when the narrator or the sheet changes it.
rulesetBuilder.presets.bands.help: Roll 2d6 plus the stat: 10 or more is a strong hit, 7 to 9 a weak hit, 6 or less a miss.
rulesetBuilder.presets.bands.label: 2d6 bands
rulesetBuilder.presets.d20.help: Roll a d20, add the stat and skill, and meet or beat the difficulty.
rulesetBuilder.presets.d20.label: d20 + modifier
rulesetBuilder.presets.duality.help: Roll two d12s plus the stat; the higher die says whether the result comes with Hope or with Fear.
rulesetBuilder.presets.duality.label: Hope and Fear
rulesetBuilder.presets.highest.help: Roll a d6 per point and keep the highest: 6 is a full success, 4 or 5 a partial one, and two 6s a critical.
rulesetBuilder.presets.highest.label: Highest d6
rulesetBuilder.presets.noDice.help: No dice are thrown. A check adds the stat and skill and compares the total with the difficulty.
rulesetBuilder.presets.noDice.label: No dice
rulesetBuilder.presets.percentile.help: Roll d100 and succeed at or under the skill's number.
rulesetBuilder.presets.percentile.label: Percentile
rulesetBuilder.presets.pool.help: Roll one die per point of stat and skill and count the dice that reach the target number.
rulesetBuilder.presets.pool.label: Dice pool
rulesetBuilder.problems.emptyPool: A pool needs a maximum above 0. Set one, or remove the pool.
rulesetBuilder.problems.emptyTrack: A track's maximum must be above its minimum. Fix it, or remove the track.
rulesetBuilder.problems.orphanSkill: A skill's stat was removed. Choose another stat for it, or remove the skill.
rulesetBuilder.problems.tooManySections: A ruleset holds up to 20 groups, counting each stat and skill group, one for each list, and one for the sheet fields. Put some rows in the same group.
rulesetBuilder.problems.unsafeText: Names and prompts can't contain square brackets, double curly braces or tabs.
rulesetBuilder.prompt.checkGuidance.help: When to ask for a check, and how to pick the skill and difficulty.
rulesetBuilder.prompt.rulesReference.hel: House rules and anything else the narrator should always have in front of it.
rulesetBuilder.prompt.sheetGuidance.help: How the sheets change during play, for the narrator.
rulesetBuilder.prompt.worldGuidance.help: Read once when a Game Mode game is created on these rules, so its world suits them.
rulesetBuilder.promptsHelp: What the narrator is told about these rules, in your own words. Where a box shows a default, leave it empty to use it. Line breaks become spaces, and square brackets or double curly braces aren't allowed.
rulesetBuilder.ranksHelp: The ranks a skill can be trained to, each with what it adds: to the total on a d20 or 2d6 roll, dice on a pool, points on a percentile. Set each character's ranks on their sheet.
rulesetBuilder.reorderHint: Drag to reorder, or use the up and down arrow keys. The sheet shows rows in this order.
rulesetBuilder.saveFailed: The ruleset could not be saved
rulesetBuilder.shipped: Already installed and rolling this way: {{names}}. To play that system, pick it in the list above instead of rebuilding it here.
rulesetBuilder.skillsHelp: Each skill rolls with the stat chosen beside it. Skills with the same group show under one heading on the sheet.
rulesetBuilder.tracksHelp: Counters that rise and fall between a minimum and a maximum.
rulesetBuilder.yours: You already have a ruleset that rolls this way: {{names}}. Each ruleset is a separate sheet on every character, so to keep one sheet, play or edit that one instead of making another.

ui.chat.customemojiselectionsettings.vis: Models that read images get one picture sheet of the custom emojis and stickers in the chat, so they know what each one looks like. A sheet holds up to 30 emojis and 12 stickers, the ones in the chat first.
